entity.summary: Open-source DIY Bitcoin signing-device project for building air-gapped, stateless hardware signers from off-the-shelf components.
entity.notes: SeedSigner is a DIY/open-source signing project, not an ordinary hardware vendor. First-party documentation explicitly says users build their own device and that there are no official or approved SeedSigner vendors.

platform: Raspberry Pi Zero and compatible DIY hardware
products.summary: DIY air-gapped stateless Bitcoin signing device built from publicly available components and SeedSigner open-source software.
products.notes: Sales status is not_applicable because SeedSigner does not define an official retail hardware product; first-party hardware guidance explicitly says there are no official or approved vendors.

evidence.title: SeedSigner: Air-gapped DIY Bitcoin Signing Device
evidence.notes: Current first-party project site describes SeedSigner as a DIY air-gapped stateless Bitcoin signing-device project built from off-the-shelf components.

evidence.title: SeedSigner Hardware
evidence.notes: First-party hardware guide lists the DIY component model and explicitly states there are no official or approved SeedSigner vendors.
